goal: Execute full 365-day on-device visual verification for the entire year 2014, capturing all 12 months for Authentic Baseline vs Cleaned Master Dataset, and generate comprehensive year report.

steps.description: Formalize acceptance criteria and present implementation plan for user review
Correct activity type enum mappings (set IN_SUBWAY to 9, IN_TRAM to 10, IN_BUS to 7, IN_TRAIN to 8)
Implement segment stitcher to merge consecutive subway/transit legs and remove sub-30s noise events
Clean polyline geometries, eliminate Jan 10 vertical spike and mid-block grid cuts
Deploy authentic Pixel 10 GMS baseline and verify physical rendering integrity
Capture all 365 days of Year 2014 for Authentic Baseline and Cleaned Master Dataset on physical Pixel 8
Compile full-year 2014 verification artifact report across all 12 months (365 days)
